about_the_game:
In the 22nd century, the Federation of Earth deploys its ultimate weapon: Gunner, a cybernetic guinea pig built to repel the Terranublans, a fanatical reptilian race that worships a rogue AI bent on galactic conquest.

Guinea Pig Gunner is an explosive side scrolling action platformer that fuses precision platforming with a massive arsenal of weapons.

Key Features

  • Move With Style: Run, jump, dash, wall climb, and teleport across 12 sprawling stages, from erupting volcanoes to frozen wastelands and futuristic metropolises.

  • Bring the Firepower: Rockets, grenades, flamethrowers, firebombs, and more. Over half a dozen weapons give you plenty of ways to shred enemies.

  • Aim Anywhere: Full 360 degree aiming with mouse or controller for precise, responsive combat.

  • Teleport to Victory: Blink through walls, telefrag enemies, ambush squads, and solve environmental puzzles with your teleporter.

  • Enemies That Hunt You: Terranublan forces chase you down on sight, striking from the air and ground, forcing constant movement and quick reactions.

  • Twelve Massive Stages: Battle through handcrafted environments filled with enemies, traps, platforming challenges, and climactic showdowns.

  • Replay and Mastery: Hidden secrets, branching paths, and combat variety encourage experimentation, exploration, and speedrunning.

Guinea Pig Gunner is a side scrolling shooter unlike anything you've ever played. Fast movement, a deep arsenal, aggressive enemies, and layers of replayability combine into a fresh, high intensity action experience.

Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or greater
  • Processor: Intel 64-bit or Apple Silicon
